summary.text: Amanda Gonzalez is the Democratic nominee. She is the elected Clerk and Recorder of Jefferson County, where she oversees elections, vehicle services and public records, and is a former executive director of Colorado Common Cause.

paragraphs.text: Attorney and former Executive Director of Colorado Common Cause; her survey response says she authored state laws creating automatic voter registration and strengthening redistricting and election security.
Elected Jefferson County Clerk and Recorder; her campaign describes her as the first Latina and first openly LGBTQ person elected to the post.
